d:
Could this be one of the city's most unexpected dining experiences?
Josh Barnes visits GRAMMIE at Sangam Courtyard, Delhi, to explore a restaurant bringing together Japanese and Italian influences, inventive fusion dishes and a striking, Hollywood-inspired dining space.
From Salmon Carpaccio, Hamachi Arangiri and Goat's Cheese Gyoza to Signature Brothless Ramen, Chipotle Seabass and Grilled Half Chicken, Josh takes on a menu that goes beyond the usual restaurant experience.
And there's dessert too! He rounds off the meal with Pistachio Tiramisu and a selection of gelatos.
